comments.note: The extractYamlBlockScalar() function could be generalized to handle block fold scalars (>) in addition to block literal scalars (|), but the current codebase only uses literal scalars for changelog. The regex already handles both via [-+]? suffix.

The validateChangelogField() INFO messages about coexisting explicit version/last_updated fields in scripts/build-personas.js will produce verbose output for all 9 personas until Phase 2 removes those fields. Once the YAML cleanup WP completes, these INFO messages should disappear automatically.

scripts/build-personas.js defines all helper functions inside the if (!CHECK) block, which limits reuse. The validateChangelogField() function references parseYamlScalars which is also scoped to that block. This is consistent with existing conventions in the file but worth noting if future expansions need these utilities elsewhere.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria verified through code inspection, direct rendering engine tests, logic unit tests, and full build execution.
AC1: resolveVersionFromChangelog() correctly extracts version from changelog block scalar — confirmed via extractYamlBlockScalar logic test (13/13 assertions pass).
AC2: Name-mapping versions verified to match explicit version fields for all 9 ledger personas — all changelog first-lines match their explicit version fields exactly.
AC3: VS Code frontmatter omits last_updated when empty — confirmed via resolveConditionals() call with empty string: 'EMPTY last_updated omitted: true'.
AC4: Claude Code frontmatter omits last_updated when empty — same conditional guard in frontmatter-templates.js, same engine behavior confirmed.
AC5: validateChangelogField() emits [WARN] for unparseable changelogs — logic verified to correctly identify absence of both withDate and withoutDate matches.
AC6: validateChangelogField() emits [WARN] for changelog entries without dates — logic verified, also confirms fallback version extraction still works.
Full build: 111 files, 9 name-mapping entries, no WARN/ERR messages (all current personas have valid dated changelogs).
ledger-plugin.test.js: 51/51 tests pass. Pre-existing failures in health-checks.test.js and install-mcp.test.js are confirmed unrelated SyntaxErrors.
--check mode: 'Build succeeded [check mode — no files written]. Personas processed: 111'.

comments.note: ledger-plugin.test.js assertions for frontmatter templates (lines 544-562) check for {{id}}, {{role}}, {{version}}, {{#if has_mcp}} but do not assert the presence of the {{#if last_updated}} guard. If the guard is accidentally removed, no automated test would catch it. Recommend adding: expect(vsTemplate).toContain('{{#if last_updated}}') and expect(ccTemplate).toContain('{{#if last_updated}}').

The persona-builder library exports resolveConditionals (not processConditionals). Future tests or scripts that need to exercise the conditional rendering engine should use require('./personas/node_modules/@mistralys/persona-builder/dist/index.cjs').resolveConditionals.

summary: Clean PASS — all 6 acceptance criteria met, no blocking issues found.

Reviewed scripts/build-personas.js (extractYamlBlockScalar, resolveVersionFromChangelog, validateChangelogField), personas/persona-build.config.js, and personas/plugins/ledger/frontmatter-templates.js.

Regex patterns confirmed consistent with src/utils/changelog.ts in persona-builder (same RE_VERSION_WITH_DATE and RE_VERSION_ONLY expressions). Behavioral note: resolveVersionFromChangelog uses multiline .match() with withDate priority — for the edge case of an undated first entry followed by a dated entry, it returns the dated version (not the first). This diverges from resolveChangelogMeta's line-by-line first-wins approach, but only fires when validateChangelogField already emits [WARN], so no regression for current data.

{{#if last_updated}} / {{/if}} guards are correctly placed in all four template locations (VS Code + Claude Code, both standalone and ledger suites). Syntax is consistent with existing {{#if has_mcp}} guards.
extractYamlBlockScalar() handles all three YAML block scalar indicators (|, |-,  |+) and correctly terminates on zero-indentation lines. Cross-platform line endings handled via /\r?\n/ throughout.
No Fix-Forward changes applied — code is clean as written.

comments.note: resolveVersionFromChangelog() uses multiline .match() with withDate checked first — for a changelog where the first entry is undated and a later entry is dated, it returns the later dated version. The persona-builder's line-by-line resolveChangelogMeta() would return the first entry regardless of date presence. Divergence only fires when validateChangelogField() already emits [WARN], so no regression for current data; still worth aligning in a future cleanup.

extractYamlBlockScalar(text, key): the key parameter is interpolated directly into new RegExp(...) without escaping. Not exploitable (internal function, hardcoded caller), but consider using key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') to make the guard explicit.

[documentation-forward] ledger-plugin.test.js frontmatter template assertions (lines ~544-562) verify {{id}}, {{role}}, {{version}}, {{#if has_mcp}} but do not assert the presence of {{#if last_updated}} in either the VS Code or Claude Code ledger templates. Add: expect(vsTemplate).toContain('{{#if last_updated}}') and expect(ccTemplate).toContain('{{#if last_updated}}').
